scope: Completed phase 1 and focused native phase 2 cleanup. No broader graph redesign, new public API, selection/display fix, commit or push.

parity.fixtureOutputs: Exact JSON plus FNV-1a digests of scalar bytes, including floating geometry/colors/weights. No epsilon comparison. Hash evidence is not collision-proof full byte storage.
parity.largeScan: All optimized full scans additionally validate every directed ID/head/sym in original flat endpoint order through E=500000 (2E halfedges). Baseline full scans above E=1000 intentionally not run; large baseline captures geometry vector, exact flat digest, counts and length total.
parity.nativeTests: 4/4 CTest passed; required Release script passed; profiling OFF in final production build.
parity.coverage: Empty, chains, loops, branches, disconnected components, isolated vertices, duplicate/reversed edges, self edges, duplicate positions/signed zero, deferred malformed-input errors, inactive vertex/edge/halfedge, escaped raw color and mutable topology, link/endpoint/ID edits, copies/assignment/move/getDuplicate, reacquired raw positions, alias bounds, averaging/colors and ribbon geometry/normals.

browser.path: Actual viewer app /src/main.ts, existing sketch-folder File import + Load; unchanged installed runtime. Graph primitives are JS-owned; no native graph ABI on this path.

samples.notes: Single browser sample. Full action includes an explicit 150ms metadata wait and polling. rAF measures scheduling, not GPU completion or FPS. JS graph path has no C++ transfer/export.
samples.status: Graph Stress 500000 built with JS zSpace API.

browser.method: Single sample per size. Includes deliberate 150ms metadata wait, polling, graph setup/conversion/publication and scheduling to built status. Earlier 1k/100k results were captured from browser output before dev-page refresh. First large attempt was lost to a page refresh; repeat on idle viewer passed. No controlled browser before/after speedup claim.
browser.camera: Wheel zoom visually verified on 500000-edge graph; canvas remained rendered and counts intact.
browser.history: Translate X=2 committed via Enter; Undo restored X=0/status Undo channel edit; Redo restored X=2/status Redo channel edit; restored X=0 afterward. Graph counts stayed V=500001/E=500000. Page keyboard shortcuts verified; native-input/button attempts that did not change state were not counted as passes.

scheduling.explanation: Discard first value: rAF timestamp is frame-start time and can precede status sampling. Remaining entries are callback intervals; no GPU fence/completion/FPS measurement.

browser.consoleErrors: No error/warn entries captured during history verification.

retainedViewCorrection.finding: Five retained-flat-pointer sequences differed from the saved DLL baseline; the original 42 cases did not exercise them.
retainedViewCorrection.fix: All six flat raw-pointer accessors use internal expose(); inspect falls back after backend or flat pointer escape. Flat escape flag is copied and retained across same-size set/edit until synchronization replaces flat storage.
retainedViewCorrection.verification: All eight public-only pointer/copy cases match old DLLs exactly. The supplemental mode never accesses Impl or internal storage, allowing safe comparison across private-layout changes.

wasm.exportParity: 12 buffers byte-identical at cube stages 0-8, through 393216 quads. This checks the reachable mesh/default ABI, not a direct native graph WASM fixture.
wasm.installation: No installed runtime replacement. Final rebuilt WASM differs from the saved build and installed viewer runtime; twelve reachable buffer outputs match exactly. Neither module exposes a direct graph ABI. The rebuilt default module also contains USD scene exports absent from the installed default module, so replacement would bundle unrelated bridge/OpenUSD work. The tested viewer graph path is JS-owned and does not consume these native iterator reads. Existing installed runtime and OpenUSD module preserved.
wasm.baselineBackups: build/graph-optimization-before/ contains source/native/runtime baseline copies; no installed-artifact replacement occurred.

viewerBuild: npm run build passed before work and after report-only harness installation. No viewer implementation/sketch/runtime edits or extraction.
memory: After native working set sampled at end of queries; process peak is cumulative across cases and includes allocator retention, not per-graph peak. No native before memory sample. Cached full topology and flat storage remain; no claim of eliminating persistent topology memory. Node JS conversion baseline records ArrayBuffer/RSS deltas; browser heap is sampled, not peak/GPU memory.

phaseBoundaries.input: Native input preparation and storage installation split in after harness; baseline recorded combined prepareAndInstall only.
phaseBoundaries.topology: Native first materialization separate from flat lengths and read-only vector/scan.
phaseBoundaries.jsCppTransfer: Not applicable to actual viewer graph path: JS-owned graph arrays. No direct graph handle ABI.
phaseBoundaries.cppExportAndReadback: Not applicable on this graph viewer path. Existing WASM mesh buffer parity measured separately; no fabricated graph transfer/export timing.
phaseBoundaries.jsConversion: Existing Node actual primitivePayloadFromGraphPayload/clone benchmark in graph-viewer-baseline.json, five trials/size through E=500000; no viewer conversion change in this patch.
phaseBoundaries.viewer: Full action-to-status and rAF callback scheduling recorded separately from graph input/JS storage; conversion/history/GPU subphases not instrumented in actual UI.

limitations: Backend and flat raw-view escape intentionally keeps the legacy expensive sync path. Backend flag resets on topology discard; flat flag persists across same-size assignments until synchronization replaces its storage. Copies retain flags conservatively.
First topology construction remains the next measured native cost; no construction, map, angular fan, incidence, BFS or algorithm redesign in this patch.
Unsupported pathological traversal and preexisting invalid guards/removeInactive behavior were preserved; this does not certify all degenerate self/duplicate-edge cyclic traversals.

Three sequential native trials, fixed before/after order, no confidence intervals. Microsecond vector figures approach timer/dispatch overhead; avoided copies and zero sync counts are the stronger evidence.
First topology timings vary with allocator/cache/system state; no construction speedup claimed.
Native smoke headers emitted existing conversion warnings; WASM emitted existing deprecation/duplicate-inline warnings; viewer build reports existing bundle-size warning.
No roadmap checkbox changed: persistent graph handles/bulk ABI milestones remain unimplemented.

Browser tool blocked file-protocol HTML preview; native app file opening is queued. Offline HTML structure/links and inline script syntax were checked; actual viewer UI and screenshot were verified over localhost.
nextBoundary: Profile and reserve first-materialization storage/maps while keeping exact construction order; then first-match flat edge lookup and insertion-order incidence/BFS membership. Viewer pre-sized primitive conversion remains a separately measured JS boundary.
preservationNote: Source hash changes outside the four edited implementation/build files were observed since the original audit and preserved. additionalTimingRuns.reason: Unchanged first-construction/flat phases varied substantially; retained initial runs and repeated both production binaries sequentially. Final comparison is a repeat, not cherry-picked minimum. No first-construction speedup claimed.
